subject: math
description: Complete a quarter performance task by designing a circular or composite floor pattern, computing area, boundary length, and material estimates.
learningObjectives: Design a circular or composite floor pattern using rectangles, triangles, circles, and semicircles
Compute the total area of a floor pattern by decomposing it into non-overlapping parts
Compute boundary length using straight sides and circular arcs
Estimate tile, border, and adhesive materials using area and boundary measurements
Explain and check a performance-task solution using correct units and reasonable rounding
